states: The same mounted PMG drawer consumes the retained real-client/provider HTTP phases: strings, invalid CID, backup failure, queue denial, version denial, recovery, scope-off and paused collection. All original phase objects remain equal to the input JSON after every update.

Recovery keeps cached failed detail degraded while the replacement detail response is held, then accepts healthy detail without closing. A later recovery wins over an obsolete adverse response. Configured target alerts clear without affecting the colliding sibling.

A controlled detail 503 renders the existing error and Retry rather than a page crash or stale panels. Pending Retry is disabled/busy and cannot dispatch again; the accepted reply restores detail in the same drawer.
Unchanged observations and clock ticks trigger no extra stored-detail read. Missing scoped readings remain dashes, not invented zero. The 320px phone reopens healthy detail with no page overflow.
interactions: Native desktop expand click and phone row tap; replay accepted producer responses and compare stored node queues, live alerts, identity and health in the actual consuming components.
Hold/release stored read-only detail responses to exercise pending recovery and obsolete-response ordering; introduce one controlled 503 per browser.
Click Retry, attempt a duplicate click while busy, accept the stored response, collapse and verify focus return; narrow the phone to 320px and reopen.
scope: Vite development preview of exact committed production consumers in an offline fixture shell. Not full App-route navigation, production-build, native-appliance, notification-delivery or released recovery acceptance.
pixel_review: All 15 retained desktop/narrow capture files opened with the native view_image tool; error, disabled Retry, restored detail and missing readings inspected. Existing narrow node-detail breakdown truncation is not repaired by this change.
